phase1_leaf_result.key_conclusion: Once GRANTED->CANCELLED wins, the reservation tombstone—not the set of cell cleanup writes—is the revocation proof. New claims can lazily CAS-reclaim stale cells by following holder reservation IDs to a current CANCELLED witness; missing evidence must fail closed, and cell identity must be incarnation-sensitive.
